Exclusive Gateway

General Concept: An Exclusive Gateway in BPMN is used to model decision points where only one outgoing path is taken based on conditions. It is the most common type of gateway for branching logic.

 

TaktX Implementation: In TaktX, Exclusive Gateways use FEEL expressions to evaluate conditions on outgoing sequence flows. The engine ensures only one path is selected based on the conditions. Variable scoping and input mappings can be used to provide data for condition evaluation.

Usage & Options in TaktX:
An Exclusive Gateway in TaktX allows you to:

  • Control process flow by evaluating conditions and selecting only one outgoing path.
  • Define conditions using FEEL expressions for each outgoing sequence flow.
  • Use input mappings to provide data for condition evaluation.
  • Configure error handling for overlapping or missing conditions.
  • Monitor gateway decisions and audit results via the TaktX client.
  • Use for decision points and branching logic in workflows.

 

Example: Order Approval Routing with Exclusive Gateway

 

This example shows a process where an Exclusive Gateway routes an order based on approval. If approved, the process continues to fulfillment; if rejected, it ends. This demonstrates decision-based routing in TaktX.

Tips & Tricks:

  • Use clear and mutually exclusive conditions for outgoing flows.
  • Document the logic for each path.
  • Test gateway behavior with different input data.

Pitfalls:

  • Overlapping or missing conditions can cause process errors.
  • Unmapped variables may lead to incorrect path selection.
